headline: Google ordered to halt Belgian data center construction over planning permit
summary: Belgian authorities ordered Google to halt construction on a large data center in southern Belgium because planning modification requests lacked formal approval.
why: Google, a subsidiary of Alphabet Inc., invests heavily in global data center infrastructure to support its cloud and search operations. Regulatory and planning disputes can delay capital expenditures and infrastructure expansion.

impacts.name: Alphabet Inc.
impacts.why: Construction halts on major data centers can temporarily impact infrastructure deployment schedules for Alphabet.
